approved_proposal: Very short tile-to-tile glide, about 80 ms, immediate start and eased arrival; whole actor with equipment and attached effects; player, monsters, drones and transformations; no input lock or gameplay change.
approval_scope: The user's reply accepts this precise movement proposal. It does not approve new character drawings or a walking animation.
presentation: Quadratic ease-out from previous displayed position to committed destination
Consecutive adjacent steps retarget immediately without queuing or blocking commands
Player camera and mouse projection share the presentation offset
Existing hit reactions compose with the glide
Actor-local status icons, burning, freezing, equipment and contact shadow share the actor rectangle
Reduced motion disables the glide; breathing is suspended while displaced
